notes: Item 19 discloses gross sales for three cohorts (all franchised, top 20%, bottom 20%) for the fiscal period December 1, 2024 through November 30, 2025. Data sourced from weekly sales reports provided by franchisees, unaudited. One minor OCR artifact in the Top 20% median ($1,136,08 4) was resolved to $1,136,084 based on context.
